payload.reason: The evidence clearly indicates that the proposed multimodal NER model integrates both text and images for named entity recognition, demonstrating its capability to learn from both modalities.

claims.text: The NER model learns from both text and images by integrating visual information with textual information.
The proposed LSTM-CNN hybrid multimodal NER network takes as input both image and text for recognizing named entities.
The model uses a modality attention module to optimize the integration of text and visual contexts for better NER performance.
